sentences.text:
MR RUTVIJ OZA, APP for the PETITIONER(s) No. 2 MR DK MODI(1317) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2,3,4 MR MD MODI(1318) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2,3,4 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 08/09/2018
On this auspicious occasion of Lok Adalat, after successful conciliation, settlement is arrived at in this matter.

Learned AGP Mr. Rutvij Oza appearing for the applicant-State of Gujarat, has tendered a withdrawal/compromise pursis dated 8th September 2018, duly signed by Shri B. P. Sharma, Food Safety Officer (authorized person) and counter-signed by learned AGP Shri Oza and Shri D. K. Modi,
learned advocate for the opponents.
The same is ordered to be taken on record.

As such, on going through the records, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the opponents-accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in R/CR.RA/693/2013 ORDER nature and the punishment or penalty prescribed for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Section 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.
In view of the above, this application stands disposed of in terms of the withdrawal/compromise pursis.
The opponents-original appellants are directed to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/ each; in lieu of State Of Gujarat.
